file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of list view pagination and filtering refactoring
key_sections: Overview with metadata (date, status, affected apps)
Before/After comparison showing problems and benefits
Complete list of 15 refactored views across 5 apps
How to use the new utility with basic and advanced examples
Real-world usage examples with code samples
Migration guide for new list views

patterns_discovered.description: Creating detailed documentation after major refactoring to explain changes, benefits, and usage patterns
patterns_discovered.context: 14+ list views consolidated into a single utility module, requiring comprehensive documentation for developer adoption

patterns_discovered.description: Documenting both the old approach (problems) and new approach (benefits) to justify refactoring decisions
patterns_discovered.context: Demonstrates code duplication, maintenance issues, and inconsistencies in old pattern vs unified utility

patterns_discovered.description: Documentation includes basic usage, advanced examples, real-world scenarios, migration guide, and troubleshooting
patterns_discovered.context: Serves multiple audience levels - from developers new to the pattern to those migrating existing code

patterns_discovered.description: Use of FilterConfig class for declarative filter definitions instead of imperative logic
patterns_discovered.context: Makes filters more readable, maintainable, and less error-prone than manual filtering code

patterns_discovered.description: Standardizing list view patterns across 5 different apps (inventory, purchasing, production, materials, labels)
patterns_discovered.context: Ensures consistent behavior and reduces cognitive load for developers working across multiple apps

gotchas_discovered.description: Must include filter parameters in pagination links to maintain current filter state when navigating pages
Must use {value} placeholder in filter_kwargs that gets replaced with actual parameter value
Date range filter must be applied before other filters to ensure proper queryset chaining
gotchas_discovered.impact: Affects filter chain order and potential query optimization

gotchas_discovered.description: Custom filter functions must accept (queryset, value) parameters and return modified queryset
gotchas_discovered.impact: Incorrect function signature will cause runtime errors

approach_outcome.description: Successfully created comprehensive refactoring documentation explaining the consolidation of 14+ list views into a centralized utility module
key_achievements: Created 678-line documentation covering all aspects of the refactoring
Documented 15 refactored views across 5 different apps
Provided three filter type patterns with clear examples
Included real-world code examples for common scenarios
Created step-by-step migration guide for new list views
Documented template integration patterns and gotchas
Established standardized pattern for future list view development
measurable_outcomes: ~40% code reduction per view mentioned as benefit
Coverage of 5 apps: inventory, purchasing, production, materials, labels
Clear before/after comparison showing 30-60 line reduction per view

recommendations.recommendation: Create automated documentation updates when new list views are created using the utility
recommendations.rationale: Documentation will become outdated as new views are added; maintaining a registry prevents inconsistencies

recommendations.recommendation: Add the migration guide section to onboarding documentation for developers working with list views
recommendations.rationale: Ensures new developers follow the standardized pattern and reduces code review iterations

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding test examples alongside the real-world examples to show proper testing patterns
recommendations.rationale: Developers will have reference tests to follow when creating new list views

recommendations.recommendation: Add a performance section documenting select_related/prefetch_related patterns for each view type
recommendations.rationale: Prevents N+1 query problems in new list views using the utility

recommendations.recommendation: Document input validation requirements and potential security considerations for filter parameters
recommendations.rationale: Ensures developers understand SQL injection risks and proper parameter handling

recommendations.recommendation: Track documentation updates in commit history to document evolution of the pattern
recommendations.rationale: Helps future developers understand design decisions and historical context
